text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Phew!
That wraps up training for today, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, max decibel record broken for today!
That definitely echoed past Sagami Bay all the way to the Pacific!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
With this... even a giant squid
would spit ink and keel right over!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"And then I'll tame it with this whistle
and plunder all the gold and silver of the Seven Seas!
Just you wait, El Doradooooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Gold Ship was up to her usual antics.
Watching the scene unfold—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible...!
Doing training that hard...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Blowing a conch horn that loudly
requires serious lung capacity.
Her cardiorespiratory fitness must be insanely well-trained...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought, I'm still...
I'm still not good enough...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
I'm gonna do a bit more independent training!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, just make sure not to overdo it.
Yeah, just make sure not to push yourself too hard.
Wait! You should rest for the rest of the day.
Wait! You should really rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
I'm gonna do a bit more independent training!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, just make sure not to overdo it.
Yeah, just make sure not to push yourself too hard.
Wait! You should rest for the rest of the day.
Wait! You should really rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha!
I can't afford to lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"If they're bringing a conch horn, then I'm bringing a trumpet!
I'll blow it with all my might!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Win Variation devoted herself to her self-directed training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I persuaded her that continuing any further would lead to overtraining, and...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Mrmph... You're totally right.
Guess I was rushing things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'll rest my body today so I can be in top shape for tomorrow's training!
